doc.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Opening at IAJE with Monk Rowe
summary: Rowe introduces the interview at the IAJE in Manhattan and frames Chirillo as guitarist and composer.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are at the IAJE in Manhattan filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton. I’m pleased to have James Chirillo with me tonight. It’s fairly late but for jazz musicians it’s about the time you’d normally start work.
Yeah. You think of yourself as a guitarist and a composer.
